svg.title: Immune cell
svg.desc: Generic leukocyte with irregular lobed nucleus, cytoplasmic granules, and flexible cell membrane. Biological basis: Leukocytes use a deformable cortex for migration and lineage-dependent nuclear lobulation for movement through confined tissue spaces.
